source.title: Nûm’ta’reen Reference Grammar v2.0_UPDATED_lphoneme.docx
source.rule: E01–E30 numbered by source order; exact raw fields retained. `orthography_index` and `english` derived for exact phrase lookup, not an inferred translation.

records.igt: nûm align ta=en 2=PAT ech EVID.WIT
records.notes: Baseline state packet; no agent expressed.
records.english: You are aligned (I witness it).

records.igt: nûm align na=ka 1=AGT ta=en 2=PAT ech EVID.WIT
records.notes: Explicit agency implies responsibility; translator arrays often over-render as a promise (“I will keep you safe”).
records.english: I align you (witnessed).

records.igt: nûm align ta=en 2=PAT na=ka 1=AGT ech EVID.WIT
records.free: “It is you I’m aligning (and it’s me doing it).”
records.notes: Late AGT signals contrast/focus in clipped briefings.
records.english: It is you I’m aligning (and it’s me doing it).

records.igt: veyl=tra boundary=TOP sekh THR ech EVID.WIT
records.free: “As for the Veil, it is in threshold state (witnessed).”
records.notes: Topic clitic helps mixed-species interlocutors track discourse anchors.
records.english: As for the Veil, it is in threshold state (witnessed).

records.igt: nûm=sha align=FOC ta=en 2=PAT ech EVID.WIT
records.notes: Translator arrays commonly miss FOC and output a bland declarative.
records.english: It’s alignment (specifically) that you’re undergoing.

records.igt: threnn’vahl record.LCH reen EVID.VRF
records.notes: Often mistranslated as “Official.” The evidential force is stronger.
records.english: The record is latched (verified across echoes).

records.igt: vahl latch/stabilize ta=en 2=PAT ech EVID.WIT
records.notes: Without consent marking, implies coercion risk.
records.english: You are stabilized/latched (witnessed).

records.igt: nûm align ta=en 2=PAT ech EVID.WIT hë Q
records.english: Are you aligned (as I witness it)?

records.igt: kesh cross mën=ka WH.PERS=AGT ta=en 2=PAT ech EVID.WIT hë Q
records.notes: WH remains in situ; Common-biased fronting is an Anchor-creole calque.
records.english: Who crossed you (witnessed)?

records.igt: vael-nûm INV-align ta=en 2=PAT ech EVID.WIT
records.english: You are misaligned (witnessed).

records.igt: ta’qesh PROH kesh cross ech EVID.WIT
records.notes: Arrays collapse to “Stop,” losing the veil-harm implication.
records.english: Do not cross (I witness the danger).

records.igt: threnn’ul’esh record.GRANT ke COMP nûm align ta=en 2=PAT reen EVID.VRF
records.free: “I grant record-access that you are aligned (verified).”
records.english: I grant record-access that you are aligned (verified).

records.igt: veyl boundary sekh THR së REL nûm align reen EVID.VRF
records.english: The threshold-veil that is aligned (verified).

records.igt: uth-nûm=uth SOFT-align=CONS
records.english: Align with permission.

records.igt: qir LOOP nûm align ta=en 2=PAT ech EVID.WIT
records.english: Your alignment is looping (witnessed).

records.igt: ruun RET veyl-sekh boundary-THR reen EVID.VRF
records.english: The veil-threshold state returns (verified).

records.igt: ta’qesh PROH
records.english: Stop. Do not proceed.

records.igt: vahl=uth latch=CONS ta=en=uth 2=PAT=CONS ech EVID.WIT
records.english: You are being stabilized, with consent (witnessed).

records.igt: threnn’vahl record.LCH vu NEG ech EVID.WIT
records.english: The record is not latched (witnessed).

records.igt: kesh cross na=ka 1=AGT veyl=va boundary=GOAL ech EVID.WIT
records.english: I cross toward the boundary (witnessed).

records.igt: kesh=uth cross=CONS na=ka 1=AGT veyl=va boundary=GOAL ech EVID.WIT
records.english: I cross (with permission) toward the boundary (witnessed).

records.igt: qir LOOP nûm align ta=en 2=PAT ech EVID.WIT hë Q
records.free: “Is your alignment looping (as I witness it)?”
records.english: Is your alignment looping (as I witness it)?

records.igt: rhel restore.balance na=ka 1=AGT veyl=en boundary=PAT reen EVID.VRF
records.english: I restore the Veil’s balance (verified).

records.igt: keth=sha ethic.eval=FOC na=ka 1=AGT kesh=en cross=PAT reen EVID.VRF
records.free: “It is the ethical evaluation I apply to this crossing (verified).”
records.english: It is the ethical evaluation I apply to this crossing (verified).

records.igt: na’vyr CLP kesh cross na=ka 1=AGT ech EVID.WIT
records.notes: Restricted to ritual disclosure or formal hazard reporting.
records.english: I crossed adjacent to a collapse (witnessed).

records.igt: ⟦…⟧=tra TRUE.NAME=TOP vu NEG ech EVID.WIT
records.free: “As for the true-name, it is not spoken (witnessed).”
records.notes: True-name taboo: teams record chords but do not vocalize.
records.english: As for the true-name, it is not spoken (witnessed).

records.igt:
threnn’vahl record.LCH
reen EVID.VRF
uth-se’run SOFT-respect.silence
records.notes: Condolence formula shaped by dead-name taboo.
records.english: The record is latched (verified). [Respect-silence].

records.igt: nûm align na=ka 1=AGT ta=en 2=PAT ech EVID.WIT ‹airlock›=va LOAN=GOAL
records.notes: Ship lexeme is contact-layer; baseline Ech’ta’reen lacks such material culture terms.
records.english: I align you (witnessed) toward the airlock.

records.igt: qesh FORB.ACT ta=en 2=PAT ech EVID.WIT
records.english: You are under the forbidden crossing-act (witnessed).

records.igt: ta’qesh PROH veyl-sekh boundary-THR ech EVID.WIT kesh cross vu NEG
records.free: “Stop. The veil is at threshold (witnessed). Do not cross.”
records.notes: Emergency chaining; Common outputs often lose the veil-state rationale.
records.english: Stop. The veil is at threshold (witnessed). Do not cross.
